data.Q: Why does Abimelek set an ambush in the fields?
data.A: Because it is reported to him that the people of Shechem go out to the fields.
data.wrong_answer: Because he sees people coming out of the city.

data.Q: Who takes position at the city entrance while others attack in the fields?
data.A: Abimelek and the companies with him.

data.Q: Whom do the two companies attack?
data.wrong_answer: The people coming out of the city.

data.Q: What does Abimelek do right before he scatters salt?
data.wrong_answer: He captures it and kills its people.

data.Q: When Abimelek sees people coming out, whom does he attack?
data.A: The people coming out of the city.

data.Q: What does Abimelek do all day until he captures the city?
data.A: He presses his attack against the city.

data.Q: Whose people does Abimelek kill when he takes the city?
